7: Abstract
8: We study the bilateral preference graphs LK(n, k) of La and Kabkab, obtained
9: as follows. Put independent and uniform [0, 1] weights on the edges of the complete
10: graph Kn. Then, each edge (i, j) is included in LK(n, k) if it is bilaterally preferred,
11: in the sense that it is among the k edges of lowest weight incident to vertex i, and
12: amongst the k edges of lowest weight incident to vertex j. We show that k = log(n) is
13: the connectivity threshold, solving a conjecture of La and Kabkab, and obtaining finer
14: results about the window. We also investigate the asymptotic behavior of the average
15: degree of vertices in LK(n, k) as n →∞.
